root_cause.text: The queue limit validation in `netem_enqueue()` incorrectly relies solely on the internal TFIFO length (`q->t_len`) rather than the total qdisc queue length (`sch->q.qlen`), allowing packets queued by the reorder path to bypass the configured queue limit.
root_cause.evidence: The CVE description states that `q->t_len` "only counts packets in the internal tfifo" while "Packets placed in sch->q by the reorder path... are not counted," and the patch diff confirms the fix by changing the condition from `q->t_len >= sch->limit` to `sch->q.qlen >= sch->limit`.

vuln_statements.explanation: This statement performs queue limit validation using q->t_len (internal TFIFO length) instead of sch->q.qlen (total qdisc queue length). According to the vulnerability root cause, this allows packets queued by the reorder path to bypass the configured queue limit because q->t_len only tracks packets in the TFIFO buffer, not all packets in the qdisc queue including those from reordering.
